title: P3-C amendment Q1 — Qwen-plus-pipeline (separately frozen experiment)
authorized_by: human (explicit ordered plan: P3-A T4 completion -> Q1 freeze -> Qwen-pipeline run -> verdict)
status: FROZEN — tag p3-c-qwen-pipeline-frozen. No change after the tag.
base_spec: P3_PIPELINE_BENCH.json (tag p3-pipeline-bench-v2, sha256 794d2799c340a4c551459465732e8a64f4c00d850db5b3b8816bef004d00109a). Read as-is; NOT modified by this amendment.
what_changes: Model ONLY (llama-3.1-8b -> qwen2.5-coder-14b-instruct) plus per-call HTTP timeouts sized for 14B CPU generation (harness, not benchmark). New runner scripts/p3c_qwen_run.py; new outputs P3_C_QWEN_PARTIAL.json (git-ignored checkpoint), P3_C_PIPELINE_QWEN.json, P3_C_QWEN_VERDICT.json.
what_does_not_change: T4 prompt (byte-identical frozen requirement), T4 temperatures (extract 0.0, candidates 0.7), token budgets (512/8/512), k=5
Verifiers/judges: frozen grade_reasoned for T4 scoring only; frozen repair.verify for R2; gold-free structural selection; deterministic ranking
Closure: single pipeline pass per case via run_once; no repair.run_task rounds added, no retry loop
Sim/FRM: optional, not-run recorded as not-run
Original llama-only evidence: P3_PIPELINE_LLAMA.json, P3_C_PIPELINE_VERDICT.json, P3_PIPELINE_BENCH.json, scripts/p3_pipeline_run.py — read-only, never written by the Qwen run

timeouts_and_resources.server_readiness_check: required before first sample; FATAL out otherwise (same as all runs)
timeouts_and_resources.host: same Windows host as all P2/P3 runs
timeouts_and_resources.exclusivity: no concurrent P3-A/P3-C/model process; checkpoints after every T4 sample and R2 case so the run is resumable
timeouts_and_resources.timeout_rule: timeouts recorded as timeouts/errors, never scored; a track with any unfinished sample is UNMEASURED, not zero
timeouts_and_resources.runtime_estimate: ~3h per T4 pipeline sample and ~0.5-1.5h per R2 case at observed 14B CPU throughput; total on the order of days. No global abort: the run continues to N=20/N=20 unless the host itself fails (recorded as interrupted).

bars.partial: exactly one track passes: track-specific finding, NOT an overall pass

regression_comparator.rule: Scoring strictly below the corresponding llama-pipeline track result is an unacceptable regression and forces overall FAIL, even if an absolute bar is met. (T4 cannot regress below 0/20; R2 regresses below 8 closes.)

verdict_rule: PASS/FAIL recorded honestly against the bars plus the regression rule, regardless of outcome. A miss is a result; bars are never relaxed.
